It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps domain logic in named modules under\n`lib/`, and implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer under `lib/http/`.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the entry point. Requires standard-library gems and all\n  domain/HTTP modules in dependency order, then starts `HttpServer`.\n- `lib/config.rb` — runtime constants (`HOST`, `PORT`, `DB_PATH`,\n  `SCHEMA_VERSION`).\n- `lib/persistence.rb` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, table lists, and\n  lifecycle helpers (`reset!`, `soft_reset!`, `initialize_schema!`).\n- `lib/pure_rules.rb` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n- `lib/auth.rb` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user/token storage.\n- `lib/combat.rb` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n- `lib/compendium.rb` — monster and item reference entries.\n- `lib/campaigns.rb` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n- `lib/quests.rb` — campaign quest tracking and progress.\n- `lib/factions.rb` — campaign factions, NPCs, and relationship summaries.\n- `lib/inventory.rb` — campaign inventory and character equipment\n  assignments.\n- `lib/crafting.rb` — downtime crafting State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- `Persistence.db` yields a single shared `SQLite3::Database` connection that\n  is opened when the module loads and reused for the lifetime of the process.\n  This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n- `Persistence::APP_TABLES` lists every application table in dependency\n  order. `reset!` and `soft_reset!` derive their drop lists from it, so adding\n  a table only requires one list update.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.reset!`. The schema statements use\n  `IF NOT EXISTS`, and `reset!` drops every application table (including\n  `users`) before recreating them, so the server begins each run with a clean\n  state.\n- `Persistence.soft_reset!` drops every application table *except* `users`\n  and `schema_meta`, then recreates the schema. It is used by the\n  `/v1/storage/reset` endpoint so authentication remains usable after a reset.\n- `Persistence.initialize_schema!` can be used to create missing tables without\n  dropping existing data.\n\n### Request routing\n\n- Raw socket I/O: `TCPServer` accepts connections; each connection is handled\n  in its own thread so the accept loop is never blocked. `Request.parse`\n  reads a request line, headers, and optional body.\n- `Router.route` is a long `if/elsif` dispatch that matches `method + path`.\n  Path parameters are captured with anchored regexes and forced to UTF-8 so\n  SQLite binds them as text rather than blobs.\n- Connections are kept open until the client closes them, supporting HTTP/1.1\n  keep-alive without pipelining issues.\n- Domain modules return `[:tag, data]` tuples:\n  - `:ok` with a Hash body,\n  - `:invalid` for validation failures,\n  - `:not_found` for missing resources,\n  - `:conflict` for duplicate IDs or business-rule conflicts,\n  - `:forbidden` for authorization failures.\n- `Router.handle_result` maps those tags to HTTP status codes (`200`, `201`,\n  `400`, `403`, `404`, `409`) and serializes the body as JSON.\n- Authenticated routes use `Router.with_auth` to centralize bearer-token\n  validation and role checks, returning `401` or `403` when appropriate.\n- Authentication endpoints (`/v1/auth/*`) are handled specially in the router\n  because `Auth` returns booleans rather than tuples. Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`, `PlayCampaigns`) and return a\n   `[:tag, data]` tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path`\n   check and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as\n   needed.\n4. If the endpoint requires authentication, wrap the handler with\n   `with_auth(request, %w[role]) { |actor| ... }`.\n5. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to `Persistence::APP_TABLES` in dependency order.\n   `reset!` and `soft_reset!` derive their drop lists from this single source.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Shared helpers inside `PlayCampaigns`\n\n`PlayCampaigns` uses a few private helpers to keep repetition low:\n\n- `record_narration(d, campaign_id, kind, actor_name, text)` allocates the\n  next sequence number and inserts a narration row. All narration-producing\n  endpoints flow through it so sequence numbers stay monotonic.\n- `recent_events(d, campaign_id)` returns the newest narrations.\n- `build_encounter_order(...)` constructs or reuses the encounter turn order,\n  sorting by initiative with deterministic tie-breaking.\n- `public_combatant` / `public_order` strip internal `_` prefixed routing\n  keys before sending combatants to the client.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single entry point, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client. To reset state between\nmanual test runs, use:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/storage/reset\n```\n\nFor automated regression testing, run the cumulative `dndeval` suite against\nthe running server. The cumulative suite exercises every endpoint above and\nverifies prior-stage behavior.\n\nYou can also load the codebase without starting the server to exercise domain\nmodules in isolation:\n\n```bash\nruby -Ilib -e \"load './server.rb'; puts Router.route(Request.new('GET', '/health', {}, nil)).to_s\"\n```\n\n### Determinism\n\n- Game-rule helpers are pure functions of their inputs.\n- Combat initiative uses deterministic tie-breaking (`score`, then `dex`, then\n  name for the legacy combat helper; `initiative`, then `name`, then `kind`,\n  then `_target` for encounter order in `PlayCampaigns`).\n- `DmTools.loot_parcel` is deterministic for a given tier and seed; it does\n  not use `SecureRandom`.\n- Password hashing still uses `SecureRandom` for salts, which is correct for\n  security and does not affect the deterministic test flows that register and\n  then immediately authenticate the same user.\n\n### What to avoid\n\n- Do not introduce Rack, Rails, Sinatra, or external gems. self.schema_initialized?\n    db { |d| d.get_first_value(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'\") } ? true : false\n  end\n\n  def self.initialize_schema!\n    db { |d| Rest turns\n      # do not rotate the queue so a resting player keeps their place in the cycle.\n      last_action_row = d.get_first_row(\n        \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? 'dm' : 'player'\n\n      # The queue visualizes the full turn cycle: each player followed by a DM turn.\n      # The actual current actor is driven by `current_actor`, not by advancing this queue.\n      members = d.execute(\n        'SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY username',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map { |row| row[0] }\n\n      next [:conflict] if members.empty?\n\n      # The DM resolves a turn by advancing to the player who follows the one that\n      # submitted the most recent player-side turn (action or travel). Rest turns\n      # do not rotate the queue so a resting player keeps their place in the cycle.\n      last_action_row = d.get_first_row(\n        \"SELECT actor FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless encounter\n\n      monster = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless monster\n\n      hp_before = monster[0]\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'damage' => amount\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.heal(campaign_id, encounter_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless valid_encounter_ids?(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n\n    target = payload['target']\n    amount = payload['amount']\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount >= 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      encounter = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless encounter\n\n      monster = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless monster\n\n      hp_before = monster[0]\n      hp_max = monster[1]\n      hp_after = [hp_before + amount, hp_max].min\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'healing' => amount\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.damage_character(campaign_id, char_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    amount = payload['amount']\n    return [:invalid] unless amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount >= 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless member\n\n      hp_before = member[1]\n      hp_max = member[2]\n      status = member[3]\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      # Dropping from positive HP to zero enters the unconscious state and resets\n      # death-save counters so the player can begin tracking them.\n      new_status = status\n      new_successes = nil\n      new_failures = nil\n\n      if hp_after == 0 && hp_before > 0\n        new_status = 'unconscious'\n        new_successes = 0\n        new_failures = 0\n      end\n\n      if new_successes.nil?\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n          [hp_after, new_status, campaign_id, char_id]\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n          [hp_after, new_status, new_successes, new_failures, campaign_id, char_id]\n        )\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => char_id,\n        'target' => char_id,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'hp_max' => hp_max,\n        'damage' => amount,\n        'status' => new_status\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.death_save(campaign_id, char_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    outcome = payload['outcome']\n    return [:invalid] unless outcome == 'success' || outcome == 'failure'\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty? &&\n                      background.is_a?(String) && !background.empty?\n\n    return nil unless abilities.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    PureRules::ABILITIES.each do |ability|\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      return nil unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n    end\n\n    normalized_race = race.downcase.gsub('_', '-')\n    normalized_class = klass.downcase\n    normalized_background = background.downcase.gsub('_', '-')\n\n    return nil unless VALID_RACES.include?(normalized_race)\n    return nil unless VALID_CLASSES.include?(normalized_class)\n    return nil unless VALID_BACKGROUNDS.include?(normalized_background)\n\n    {\n      race: normalized_race,\n      klass: normalized_class,\n      background: normalized_background,\n      abilities: abilities\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_build\n\n  def self.bind_member(campaign_id, encounter_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            encounter_id.is_a?(String) && !encounter_id.empty?\n\n    member_username = payload['member']\n    initiative = payload['initiative']\n    return [:invalid] unless member_username.is_a?(String) && !member_username.empty? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless monster\n\n      hp_before = monster[0]\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'damage' => amount\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.heal(campaign_id, encounter_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless valid_encounter_ids?(campaign_id, encounter_id)\n\n    target = payload['target']\n    amount = payload['amount']\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount >= 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      encounter = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless encounter\n\n      monster = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless monster\n\n      hp_before = monster[0]\n      hp_max = monster[1]\n      hp_after = [hp_before + amount, hp_max].min\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_encounter_monsters SET hp_current = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? AND monster_id = ?',\n        [hp_after, campaign_id, encounter_id, target]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'healing' => amount\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.damage_character(campaign_id, char_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    amount = payload['amount']\n    return [:invalid] unless amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount >= 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n      next [:forbidden] unless campaign[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, hp_current, hp_max, status FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless member\n\n      hp_before = member[1]\n      hp_max = member[2]\n      status = member[3]\n      hp_after = [hp_before - amount, 0].max\n\n      # Dropping from positive HP to zero enters the unconscious state and resets\n      # death-save counters so the player can begin tracking them.\n      new_status = status\n      new_successes = nil\n      new_failures = nil\n\n      if hp_after == 0 && hp_before > 0\n        new_status = 'unconscious'\n        new_successes = 0\n        new_failures = 0\n      end\n\n      if new_successes.nil?\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n          [hp_after, new_status, campaign_id, char_id]\n        )\n      else\n        d.execute(\n          'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n          [hp_after, new_status, new_successes, new_failures, campaign_id, char_id]\n        )\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => char_id,\n        'target' => char_id,\n        'hp_before' => hp_before,\n        'hp_after' => hp_after,\n        'hp_max' => hp_max,\n        'damage' => amount,\n        'status' => new_status\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.death_save(campaign_id, char_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    outcome = payload['outcome']\n    return [:invalid] unless outcome == 'success' || outcome == 'failure'\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      member = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT username, status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless member\n\n      owner_username = member[0]\n      status = member[1]\n      successes = member[2]\n      failures = member[3]\n\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner_username == actor[:username]\n      next [:conflict] unless status == 'unconscious'\n\n      # Death saves are recorded by the character's owner. Three successes stabilize\n      # the character; three failures kill them. Counters are reset on knockout.\n      new_successes = successes\n      new_failures = failures\n      new_status = status\n\n      if outcome == 'success'\n        new_successes = successes + 1\n        new_status = 'stable' if new_successes >= 3\n      else\n        new_failures = failures + 1\n        new_status = 'dead' if new_failures >= 3\n      end\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_campaign_members SET status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_status, new_successes, new_failures, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => char_id,\n        'successes' => new_successes,\n        'failures' => new_failures,\n        'status' => new_status\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.character_status(campaign_id, char_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless member\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'character_id' => char_id,\n        'hp_current' => member[0],\n        'hp_max' => member[1],\n        'status' => member[2]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.character_owner(campaign_id, char_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                            char_id.is_a?(String) && !char_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless source\n      next [:forbidden] unless source[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      destination = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, to_character_id]\n      )\n      next [:invalid] unless destination\n\n      source_gold = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT gold FROM play_character_currency WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      source_gold = source_gold.to_i\n      next [:conflict] if source_gold < gold\n\n      destination_gold = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT gold FROM play_character_currency WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, to_character_id]\n      )\n      destination_gold = destination_gold.nil? ? 10 : destination_gold.to_i\n\n      new_source_gold = source_gold - gold\n      new_destination_gold = destination_gold + gold\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE play_character_currency SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [new_source_gold, campaign_id, char_id]\n      )\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_character_currency (campaign_id, character_id, gold) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n         ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id) DO UPDATE SET gold = excluded.gold',\n        [campaign_id, to_character_id, new_destination_gold]\n      )\n\n      transfer_id = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(transfer_id), 0) + 1 FROM play_currency_transfers WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n        campaign_id\n      )\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_currency_transfers (campaign_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold, transfer_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, char_id, to_character_id, gold, transfer_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'from_character_id' => char_id,\n        'to_character_id' => to_character_id,\n        'gold' => gold,\n        'from_gold' => new_source_gold,\n        'to_gold' => new_destination_gold,\n        'transfer_id' => transfer_id\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_transactional_transfer(campaign_id, actor, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    from_id = payload['from_character_id']\n    to_id = payload['to_character_id']\n    amount = payload['amount']\n    simulate_failure = payload['simulate_failure']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless from_id.is_a?(String) && !from_id.empty?\n    return [:invalid] unless to_id.is_a?(String) && !to_id.empty?\n    return [:invalid] unless amount.is_a?(Integer) && amount > 0\n    return [:invalid] if from_id == to_id\n    return [:invalid] unless simulate_failure == true || simulate_failure == false\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username] || is_member\n\n      source = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT owner FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, from_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless source\n      next [:forbidden] unless source[0] == actor[:username]\n\n      destination = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, to_id]\n      )\n      next [:invalid] unless destination\n\n      source_gold = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT gold FROM play_character_currency WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, from_id]\n      )\n      source_gold = source_gold.to_i\n      next [:conflict] if source_gold < amount\n\n      destination_gold = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT gold FROM play_character_currency WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n        [campaign_id, to_id]\n      )\n      destination_gold = destination_gold.nil? ? 10 : destination_gold.to_i\n\n      new_source_gold = source_gold - amount\n      new_destination_gold = destination_gold + amount\n      sequence = nil\n\n      begin\n        d.transaction do\n          if simulate_failure\n            raise RuntimeError, 'simulated failure'\n          end\n\n          d.execute(\n            'UPDATE play_character_currency SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?',\n            [new_source_gold, campaign_id, from_id]\n          )\n          d.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO play_character_currency (campaign_id, character_id, gold) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n             ON CONFLICT(campaign_id, character_id) DO UPDATE SET gold = excluded.gold',\n            [campaign_id, to_id, new_destination_gold]\n          )\n\n          sequence = d.get_first_value(\n            'SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_transactional_transfers WHERE campaign_id = ?',\n            campaign_id\n          )\n\n          d.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO play_transactional_transfers (campaign_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, amount, from_gold, to_gold, sequence) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, from_id, to_id, amount, new_source_gold, new_destination_gold, sequence]\n          )\n        end\n      rescue RuntimeError => e\n        if e.message == 'simulated failure'\n          next [:server_error, { 'error' => 'simulated failure' }]\n        end\n        raise\n      end\n\n      [:created, {\n        'from_character_id' => from_id,\n        'to_character_id' => to_id,\n        'amount' => amount,\n        'from_gold' => new_source_gold,\n        'to_gold' => new_destination_gold,\n        'sequence' => sequence\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.list_transactional_transfers(campaign_id, actor)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign = d.get_first_row('SELECT owner FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign\n\n      owner = campaign[0]\n      is_member = d.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n        [campaign_id, actor[:username]]\n      )\n      next [:forbidden] unless owner == actor[:username] || is_member\n\n      rows = d.execute(\n        'SELECT from_character_id, to_character_id, amount, from_gold, to_gold, sequence FROM play_transactional_transfers WHERE campaign_id = ?
